about: Follow-up turns for the async-judge carry-forward bench (haystack-bench.ts). Each labelled turn of recall-cases.json and each update turn of haystack-cases.json gets the next thing the caller says on the same subject, written vaguer than the first turn (pronouns, no names), the way people continue. The follow-up expects the same memories as the turn it follows. Every value here is invented.

Sam: how's the pup doing, he was limping
he's still favoring that one leg a bit
the vet said his paw is fine
so no more of those expensive visits for a while
what's my dog like again
I'm trying to describe him to my new neighbor
I finally booked the tickets to Portugal
now I just need to figure out what to pack
my sister's big day is coming up soon
I still haven't written a toast for her
my mom is walking again without the brace
she even did the stairs by herself yesterday
work's been rough, my boss pushed the date up again
I don't see how we'll ship it by then
Priya did it again in the standup today
she presented my numbers like they were hers
someone at work took credit for my slides
I'm not sure whether to say something to her
I made a bowl on the wheel last night
it came out a little lopsided but I love it
my clay class got cancelled this week
the instructor was sick, so it's pushed to next week
I ran eight miles this morning
my legs are already feeling it
the training plan for the race is killing me
four runs a week is a lot with work
I can finally play an F chord
my fingers hurt but it actually rings out now
I've been up at three every night this week
I just lie there thinking about work
what were you reading again
you told me about it a while ago
the mechanic finally changed the oil
it took him all of twenty minutes
I had the best noodle soup downtown
it was so spicy my eyes watered
my teeth cleaning got moved
now it's on the same day as my big meeting
the bouldering wall wrecked my forearms
I could barely hold my coffee this morning
I'm heading to the gym after this
trying to get a session in before dinner
my new manager Dev wants a one-on-one
I've only talked to him twice so far
the fraud team standup ran long again
half the team had updates about the same ticket
the movers are booked for the first
I haven't packed a single box yet
my new place in Highland has a balcony
I want to put a couple of chairs out there
Maria: Lucia didn't cry at all this morning when I dropped her off
she just waved and ran to the other kids
my little one starts school in two weeks
we still need to buy her a backpack
the tomatoes are finally turning red
I'm going to have way too many this year
something keeps eating my pepper plants
there are holes in half the leaves
I think the interview went really well
they asked a lot about how I handle the floor
they offered me the charge nurse job
I start the new role in three weeks
I visited my father and he didn't know who I was
he called me by my aunt's name the whole time
Diego has been so tired from all the nights
he sleeps through most of the afternoon
we looked at houses in Austin this weekend
one of them was ten minutes from my sister
ten years married next month, can you believe it
we're thinking about a weekend away
I paid off another chunk of the card
only a few hundred left now
Rosa and I finally got lunch together
we talked for three hours like old times
do you have any plants at your place
or do you not really have the touch for them
I skipped my stretching class this Sunday
my back is already complaining about it
this weekend's twelve-hour shifts are going to wreck me
I'll barely see the kids
I'm working Saturday and Sunday again
so no farmers market for us this week
the Subaru handled the rain great
it felt so much steadier than the old car
what am I driving these days, I keep forgetting
I swear my brain is mush lately
Lucia loves her new teacher
she talks about him all through dinner
Mr. Chen sent home a note about reading time
he wants twenty minutes a night
James: Toby hit a double in the big game
you should have seen him run to second
my grandson's team made the playoffs
first game is next Saturday morning
I finished sanding the chair legs
next comes the stain, if my hands hold up
Christmas is coming and I dread it without her
the house is so quiet in December
today would have been Ellen's birthday
I bought the flowers she liked anyway
the new pills make me dizzy
especially when I stand up too fast
we gave out two hundred meals at the pantry
the line went around the block
Walt called me out of the blue yesterday
I didn't know what to say to him at first
I miss being out on the water
nothing like a quiet morning with a line in
the old guy barely made it around the block today
he had to sit down twice
did your father do any woodworking
or was he more of a fix-it-yourself type
I used to run a lathe all day at the plant
my ears still ring from those years
my new doctor wants to see me in a month
she wants to check how I'm doing on everything
Dr. Okafor says my numbers look better
she was pleased with the last reading
Rusty finally likes the soft food
he licked the bowl clean this morning
what does the dog eat now, I forget
I need to pick some up at the store
Toby looked good behind the plate
he threw out a runner at second
what position is my grandson playing these days
I want to know what to watch for on Saturday
